expected: 삼팔팔삼 다시 공육육일 다시 구오이일로 조회
notes: Authored 2026-09-29 before the change. A bare hyphenated number whose sides differ in length with the longer at 5+ digits, a side of 6+ digits or a leading-zero group is an identifier, not a range (resident, account, order numbers); a date-shaped run that is not a date (3883-0661-9521) is read too instead of reaching TTS as raw digits. Speech reads them with the identifier grammar; text keeps the rejected object literally. Counted, year, small, equal-length and grouped money ranges and a malformed YYYY-MM-DD date are guards.
